parameters.name: DatasetName
parameters.description: The dataset name. For more information, see [Create a dataset](~~478160~~).

parameters.name: DateOptions
parameters.description:
The date clustering settings.
><notice>Modifying this setting also affects existing spatio-temporal clusters in your `Dataset`.></notice>

parameters.name: LocationOptions
parameters.description:
The location clustering settings.
><notice>Modifying this setting also affects existing spatio-temporal clusters in your `Dataset`.></notice>

parameters.name: Notification
parameters.description: The message notification configuration. For more information, see Notification. For the format of asynchronous notification messages, see [Asynchronous notification message format](~~2743997~~).

parameters.name: ProjectName
parameters.description: The project name. For more information, see [Create a project](~~478153~~).

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: Custom tags used to search for and filter asynchronous tasks.

parameters.name: UserData
parameters.description: Custom information that is returned in the asynchronous notification message. This helps you associate the notification message with your system. The maximum length is 2,048 bytes.
